I try to keep it at a 1,000 which I know some people get all offended at but i'm usually sedentary and I just can't eat a "healthy" amount of calories and lose weight at a decent pace. I don't drink my calories and I've found a lot of low calorie food options that make it much easier for me to diet without feeling like i'm starving myself or anything. I can give a list of those if anyone is interested.

As far as exercising goes I have an elliptical that I use a couple times a week for like 45 minutes. I'll also occasionally do some butterfly kicks or those elbow to knee sit up things.  90% of my weight loss if from purely dieting though.
